sentences.text: Dalingheornis is classified in the class Reptilia.
It belongs to the parent group Euenantiornithes.
The animal lived during the early Cretaceous period approximately 122 million years ago.
Its time range extended from the Barremian to the Aptian, between 125.77 and 119.57 million years ago.
Scientists debate whether the long tail was a specific feature of the species or merely a juvenile characteristic.
In 2009, Jingmai O'Connor considered Dalingheornis to be a nomen dubium because its remains were stored in a private collection.
